snapshot.description: Fix Ratatui TUI issues: (1) Dashboard — replace Paragraph with Scrollbar+List for >50 pages, (2) Search — support Ctrl+V paste via raw mode, cycle results with Enter to preview, (3) Graph — allow selecting center node via search, (4) Tab cycling — Tab/Shift+Tab to cycle tabs, (5) Help overlay — ? key shows all bindings.
snapshot.title: TUI: Dashboard Scrolling + Search Polish
